criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame is a world. Frames 2, 5 and 8 come nearest the place-at-an-hour test. Frame 4 is a speckle plain under a hard horizon with the hull a sub-pixel speck. Frame 7's lower part is a flat near-black water slab with untextured white boxes. Frame 6 has a ponytail clipping a hat brim, a rolled-cylinder flag, a blank seal and mostly empty chairs. On frame 1 the mast's sensor ball touches the dek's last line. Noon light throws few readable cast shadows. Frames 5 and 9 leave the lower half as empty gravel.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hull, one noon grade, one plan-ink accent with a fixed meaning, medians 42.4 to 61.7 with no strobe. The hull's states and the 05 to 09 camera both work. Frames 4 and 7 read as a different stock.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. The county half rests on the Tribune where a county order exists. Frame 3 sets Marauder figures beside the first phase's landing craft so a reader can infer the yard builds Marauders. The first comment omits c4 though the caption prints $3 billion.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A Texan learns what happened, who decided and where, and the stakes, schools, the 35% local share and the shrinking clause. Nothing they can do: no next meeting, no place to read the agreement, no taxing units named. Five of nine frames carry Saronic's specs.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, frames 2 and 3 do not pay it, frames 4, 5 and 7 are three yard-dimension frames. The turn at 6 lands and the close on 9 is good.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and honest, not yet a Texan writing. No Valley texture. Frames 2 and 3 read as relayed press release and the drawn disclaimer repeats on seven frames.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A fresh subject and palette. One object carried through its states repeats the house template since no. 39, and a local incentive story follows no. 44's.

one_sentence_fix: Replace frames 2 and 3 with the county half of the story from Cameron County's own pages, so the middle pays the cover and the close has a next step.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A speckle plain under a hard horizon with the square floating on it and the hull an invisible speck
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the camera to a 150 m oblique from over the channel so the bank, water and hull own the lower third and the square recedes behind them

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat near-black water slab over a beige band, untextured white boxes, more buildings than the release's 8 to 10
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower and pitch the camera so the bank, quay line and a moored hull sit in the lower third, and draw at most 10 production buildings with roof and wall detail

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A ponytail clipping a hat brim, a rolled-cylinder flag, a blank seal and mostly empty rows
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Swap the foreground figure for a hatless resident and seat 6 to 8 more residents across the rows

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The mast's sensor ball touches the dek's last line and the hull reads as a primitive
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the hull or raise the camera so the mast top clears the dek baseline by 40 px

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The hull is cropped behind the dek and the lower half is empty gravel
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull the camera back and lower the horizon so the whole hull sits below the dek and the block line and person fill the lower third
